description.value: Blue Canoe Waterfront Restaurant sits on Bayview Pier in historic Steveston Village, offering unobstructed views of the water, the busy boardwalk, and Fisherman's Wharf. A multi-year winner of Richmond's Best Restaurant award, it focuses on fresh, locally sourced seafood — ingredients drawn wherever possible directly from Richmond farms — prepared with simple techniques by Chef Cezar Taneo. Touring cyclists exploring the Steveston waterfront would find it a notable full-service destination with an extensive BC-focused wine and beer list.
